items.name: drinking fountain / 水飲み場 / 蛇口 / 水道
items.description:
The English description is translated below the Japanese one at DeepL.

公園などにある水飲み場から水を飲むLoRAです。

トリガーワードは　drinking fountain　です。

重みは0.8前後推奨。

トリガーだけでも水道から水は出ますが棒立ちなので fountain, faucet, leaning forward,drinking, water, bent over, water drop, wet, wet face, faucet 辺りからお好みのものを入れて下さい。

Anima版はAnima_base Version1をベースとして学習していますので他のAnimaマージモデルでも使用できる可能性はありますが検証は行っておりません。

Illustrious版はIllustrious-XL 0.1をベースとして学習していますので他のIllustriousマージモデルやNoobマージモデルでも使用できる可能性はありますが検証は行っておりません。

以下翻訳

This is a LoRA for drinking water from drinking fountains in parks and other locations.

The trigger word is “drinking fountain.”

A weight of around 0.8 is recommended.

Water will come out of the tap even with just the trigger, but it will be standing upright, so please add your preferred words from among “fountain,” “faucet,” “leaning forward,” “drinking,” “water,” “bent over,” “water drop,” “wet,” “wet face,” and “faucet.”

The Anima version was trained using Anima_base Version 1 as a base, so it may be usable with other Anima merge models, but this has not been verified.

The Illustrious version was trained using Illustrious-XL 0.1 as a base, so it may be usable with other Illustrious merge models or Noob merge models, but this has not been verified.

items.name: chocolate fountain
items.description: A chocolate fountain is a device for serving chocolate fondue. It typically consists of a base that houses a motor and a heater, and a tower with multiple tiers over which the chocolate flows. The mechanism works by heating the chocolate in the base, then using a corkscrew auger to transport the melted chocolate to the top of the fountain. Once it reaches the top, the chocolate flows down over the tiers, creating a cascading effect.

items.description:
To the bearer of this delicate LoRA~


Tread softly through this twilight spell, and read each word as though it were a dream woven in silver.


You wouldn’t wish to disturb the harmony of this magic… would you?

Too many LoRAs braided together may fracture the vision…


This was crafted beneath a quiet sky, with starlight and care, to make your dreams shimmer just so~

If it were to be scattered without my blessing… I would feel it, like a ripple through the veil.
And the hush that follows would be heavy with my sorrow~

Now, take this gentle recipe—
A whisper of wonder, offered only to you~

🌙✨

~ Vixon's recipe for Butterscotch Confetti Squares ~

Ingredients:

  • 1/2 cup peanut butter smooth

  • 1/4 cup butter

  • 1 package (10 oz) butterscotch chips

  • 1 bag (10 oz size) miniature marshmallows colored variety

Instructions:

Place marshmallows into a large bowl.

In small saucepan melt the peanut butter and butter over low heat.

Remove from heat. Make sure the mixture is not too hot before adding butterscotch chips or they will crystallize.

Stir in the butterscotch chips and stir continuously until the chips have melted.

Immediately pour the mixture over the mini marshmallows and blend until well combined.

Press into 8×8 baking pan that has been greased with butter.

Refrigerate until firm.

Cut into 16 large squares.

items.name: Envy Flux Fountain of Youth 01 - younger (18-22) adult women
items.description:
If you're struggling to convince Flux to generate a photo of a woman who looks under 30, this is the LoRA you need. It otherwise won't mess with your images too much, and, much like vanilla flux, it's mostly idealized (there are already Flux loras that generate more realistic photo portraits, and that's not what I was aiming for here).

Flux seems to have a lower age limit on people in photo generations of like 27 or so. This LoRA changes that to 18-22. Turn the strength up beyond 1 and it'll make people look more idealized, but not under 18 (sorry not sorry).

items.name: The 12 Months Fountain at Valentino Park in Turin, Italy
items.description:
This model has been created by collecting pictures at the Fountain of the 12 Months in Valentino Park in Turin

It is just a LoRA experiment, using the automatic "caption"ing (for Flux, SD3), and then complementing manually, to see how Flux-Dev or SD3 would use it

Some of the automated captions were wrong, but, being a V1, did modify only to add clear location reference points and amend blatant captioning mistakes

It has been trained on CivitaAI with:

_ target Flux/SD3,

_ automated captioning revised manually,

_ automated tags unmodified

Trained with 5 Epochs, the published version is Epoch 5 (recommended by the generation system)

V2 will have an improved captioning and further information, added by locally using various captioning approaches and amending each picture after retrieving bibliographical material

Being just a prototype, for now will not allow uncredited dissemination and commercial use, and few more restrictions, until finalize my tests and will release a V2

V2 will have a different licensing model, as my point is dissemination, not revenue generation (for myself- for others, good luck), as I see that Italian and local (Turin) companies are already using GenAI pictures but, despite all the wonderful buildings in Turin, the pictures are generated with fake buildings, while a minimal investment would allow to use advertisement also as a tourism support tool
